highResolutionMaterials: External source archives or separately downloadable, permission-reviewed research packets

records.title: Hereford Mappa Mundi
records.summary: Medieval Christian world picture with Jerusalem at its center, illustrating religious history and legends.
records.evidence: Approximate date and interpretive medieval cartography.

records.title: Fra Mauro World Map
records.summary: Venetian parchment map documenting geographic information known around 1450.
records.evidence: Approximate date; source reports are not equivalent to modern surveying.

records.title: Ptolemy's World Map (1478 printing)
records.summary: Early printed representation of the ancient Ptolemaic geographical framework.
records.evidence: 1478 is the printing date, not the date of Ptolemy's original writings.

records.title: Waldseemüller World Map
records.summary: Twelve-sheet world map recognized for using the name America.
records.evidence: Contemporary depiction of early sixteenth-century geographical knowledge.

records.title: Urbano Monte Planisphere
records.summary: Sixty-sheet north-polar world projection with art, annotations, and speculative southern geography.
records.evidence: Map projection and speculative Antarctica do not establish a flat Earth or hidden southern territories.

records.title: Nicolas Sanson World Map
records.summary: French two-hemisphere world map showing California as an island.
records.evidence: The depiction documents period mapping and historical errors.

records.title: Sanson and Berry World Map
records.summary: London-published double-hemisphere world map with period geographical conventions.
records.evidence: Historical source is documented, not all depicted coastlines.

records.title: Japanese Buddhist World Map
records.summary: Traditional religious cartography centered on India and Buddhist cosmological themes.
records.evidence: A historical cosmological portrayal, not modern scientific geography.

records.title: Herman Moll World Map
records.summary: Large hand-colored world map published in London.
records.evidence: Source and date documented; cartography reflects its period.

records.title: Hermann Berghaus Mercator World Chart
records.summary: Detailed world chart showing travel routes, sea ice and inset maps.
records.evidence: Tenth edition, 1882; the first edition was in 1863.

records.title: Goldthwaite Globe Map
records.summary: World hemispheres and climate-zone cartography issued in 1900.
records.evidence: Publication details confirm historical map; not a modern climate survey.

records.title: The Times Atlas Mapping of the World
records.summary: 1922 atlas plate comparing ancient, medieval and modern cartographic traditions.
records.evidence: Historical maps depicted within must be credited to their respective traditions.

records.title: NASA Blue Marble: Next Generation
records.summary: Modern satellite-derived global images showing monthly seasonal changes.
records.evidence: Composite of many observations, not a single instantaneous photograph.
